title: Three countries. *One local host.*
intro: Georgia is home; Armenia and Azerbaijan are next door. One team in Tbilisi designs and runs programmes in all three — one country at a time, or combined in a single journey with the border crossings arranged by us.

countries.summary: Our home: a small country with huge variety, from the high Caucasus to the Black Sea and the wine valleys of Kakheti.
highlights: Tbilisi, Mtskheta and the road to Kazbegi
Kakheti wine country and qvevri cellars

map.label: Schematic map of the South Caucasus
map.description: Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan between the Black Sea in the west and the Caspian Sea in the east, with the Greater Caucasus range along their northern edge. Tbilisi, in eastern Georgia, is marked with the red sun. Lines lead from Tbilisi north to Kazbegi, west to Kutaisi and on to Batumi on the Black Sea, south to Yerevan in Armenia, and east to Sheki and on to Baku on the Caspian. Russia lies to the north, Turkey to the south-west and Iran to the south.

aside.title: Between two seas, *three capitals.*
aside.text: Tbilisi sits between the Black Sea and the Caspian, with Yerevan to the south and Baku to the east. When a programme combines two or three countries, our team arranges the transfers, the timings and the border crossings — so your group travels on one plan, with one team behind it.
aside.note: By road. Traffic, weather and border queues can change them — and border rules change too, Azerbaijan’s above all, so ask us for the current situation before you plan a crossing.
